(ii) Bidders Shop and establishment registration certificate or registration certificate from registrar of firms or certificate of incorporation from Registrar of Companies (Not required for permanent registered vendors with MDL). B) Technical Qualification Criteria: - i) Experience of manufacture and supply: - The bidder must have regularly manufactured and supplie d similar product with the same or higher specifications for at least the last three years (3) financial years, ending 31st March (or any other year ending followed in relevant country) of the preceding financial year. ii) Past Supply performance: - The bidder must have supplied of similar type of RT/X-ray accessories (i.e .) CR Phantom & duplex image quality indicators etc.) with minimum quantity of one (1) number of ‘The qu oted Product’ during anyone (1) year within the last three (3) years, ending on ’The relevant tender closin g date’. iii) OEM authorized certificate: - The bidder must be the OEM/OEM authorized dealer. A valid OEM auth orized certificate shall be submitted along with the technical bid. Note: (a) Start-ups shall be given 100% relaxation in prior turnover and prior experience subject to meeting of qu ality and technical specification and bidder shall submit the valid Start-up certificate as recognized by Dep artment of Industrial policy and Promotion (DIPP). (b) MSEs shall be given 100% relaxation in prior turnover and prior experience subject to meeting of qualit y and technical specification and bidder shall submit the valid MSE Udyam certificate. 2) Delivery Period 90 days from date of Order Placement. Deviation in delivery period will be liable for bi d rejection. 3) The offer of the firms who are blacklisted by MDL/GeM shall be rejected and shall not be Considered. 4) Detailed ATC including Technical Specification, Scope of Work, safety instructions to sub-contractor, Lo cal Content, is uploaded with Buyer Uploaded ATC document. 5) Bid Rejection Criteria: A) The following conditions / deviations are non-negotiable and therefore any bid falling under these condi tions / deviations shall be summarily rejected. Bidders to note that they shall not be provided any opportu nity to rectify these conditions / deviations post bid opening: (i) Bids received after tender closing date and time.

(ii) Bids received other than through GeM e-portal. (iii) Bidders who are debarred under PPP MII order 2017, GeM, CPPP including Tender holiday issued by MD L. (iv) Bids received without EMD (other than those who are exempted from payment of EMD). B) Non-compliance/non-acceptance to any of the terms and conditions of the tender shall render the bid lia ble for rejection. Deviation in delivery period will be liable for bid rejection. Acceptance of detailed Scope of Work/ Technical Specification as attached in SOW of bid document (Sign and Stamp On each Page Of SOW) ii. Purchase Order copies and its work completion certificates as per Technical Pre-Qualification Criteri a. iii. OEM authorization certificate (on OEM letterhead) or if bidder is OEM for Offered Product, then decl aration of OEM for offered product on their letter head required as per Enclosure-6. iv. Average turnover including Audited Balance Sheet & Profit & Loss Statement for last 3 years, F.Y.202 2-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 as per Commercial Prequalification Criteria. vii. Bidders Shop and establishment registration certificate or registration certificate from registrar of firm s or certificate of incorporation from Registrar of Companies as per Commercial Prequalification Criteria. viii. GSTIN certificate all pages ix. PAN card x. Cancelled Cheque xi. NEFT mandate certified by bank (Bank account details certified by bank). xii. Local Contain Declaration on OEM letter head (As per Enclosure 1 in GeM tender) xiii. Undertaking of conflict of interest as per Enclosure-7 (Sign and Stamp On each Page) xiv. Bidder should fill the format of Enclosures- 1 to 11 & submit with Sign and Stamp on each Page. xv. Acceptance of all Tender terms & conditions (i.e., ePBG, Warranty, Delivery Period, Offer Validity, Pa yment Terms, LD applicability, GeM GTC, etc.) on Bidder letter head (Any Deviation not acceptable) . 12.
